letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden glow of your smile, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. Today, as the calendar turns to a new page, I find myself grateful for the countless moments we share—your laughter, your gentle touch, the way you call me “cutie” and melt my heart. No distance can dim the love that binds us; you are my forever adventure, my home, and the sweetest part of every day.
poem:
Across the dunes or by the river’s flow,  
Your love’s the compass that I always know.  
In every season, warm or cool, we blend,  
Together, jaan, our story never ends.
